description: This Java class defines a Vert.x HTTP resource for scraping metrics from a PrometheusMeterRegistry. It provides endpoints to retrieve Prometheus metrics via HTTP.

classes.name: PrometheusScrapingResource
classes.description: A Vert.x handler that exposes an HTTP endpoint to serve Prometheus metrics gathered in a PrometheusMeterRegistry. It is conditionally loaded if the Micrometer Prometheus class is available and is a Spring component.

methods.name: PrometheusScrapingResource
methods.description: Constructor accepting a PrometheusMeterRegistry instance; initializes the resource with a metrics registry.

methods.name: scrape
methods.description: Private method triggered on HTTP GET to scrape and return metrics from the registry.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Registers the '/prometheus' endpoint on the provided Vert.x Router, associating it with the scrape handler.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the scraper resource, including its endpoint URI.
